newsitem.title: UK: Burnfield unit buys U.S. instruments firm.
newsitem.headline: Burnfield unit buys U.S. instruments firm.

text.p: Malvern Intruments, a division of Burnfield Plc, has acquired a U.S. measurements firm for $3.0 million, the group said in a statement.
Burnfield said Malvern would pay $1.5 million in cash on completion of the contract and the balance a year later for Insitec, based in California.
Insitec specialises in laser-based measuring instruments and had achieved sales of $1.77 million and a pretax profit of 0.15 million for the year ended December 31, 1995.
The firm, founded by Don Holve, a research scientist had net assets of 0.20 million as on that date.
Holve and a few of his colleagues have entered into two-year employment contracts with Malvern, the statement said.
